content_of_post_to_comment: Polymaths. Generalists. Synthesists. Philosophers. Creatives. Artists. Writers. These are the people who will thrive in the AI age. The old world rewarded specialists, but the new world rewards a different kind of human. People who connect ideas. People who imagine what does not yet exist. People who create meaning, culture, and experiences. AI can generate outputs, but humans create worlds.
